metadata.title: Portfolio — Enzo Interiors
metadata.description: Every kitchen, bedroom, media wall and wardrobe we have finished across Leicestershire — with the client, the location, the time on site and the materials specified.

wall.label: Wall
wall.lede: Filter by discipline and the wall rearranges rather than reloading. Any tile opens its case study.

anatomy.label: In full
anatomy.lede: The wall above is nine thumbnails. This is what is behind one of them — who it was for, how long we were in their house, what it is made of, and what actually got decided.
anatomy.ledeShort: What is behind one of those thumbnails: who, where, how long, and what it is made of.

close.label: Your turn
close.heading: We asked {count} other people these three things first.
close.lede: Every room above started as three answers given at somebody’s kitchen table. None of them needed measurements, a budget worked out to the pound, or any idea what the finished thing should look like — that part is our job, and it starts after this.

questions.why: A kitchen and a walk-in are different trades wearing the same coat. Knowing which one tells us who needs to come and look at it, and how long they should put aside.

questions.ask: What is wrong with it now?
questions.why: Nobody replaces furniture that works. The thing that annoys you daily is usually the thing the design has to solve first — and it is rarely the thing people lead with.

questions.ask: What would you rather not spend?
questions.why: Not a haggle. Knowing the ceiling early is what lets us say honestly whether the room you have described can be done for it, before either of us has spent an afternoon on drawings.

close.footerNote: Answer them in about a minute. We reply the same working day, and the survey after it is free with nothing to sign.
